_note: Playstyle for the Freestyle sword deck: a Drill deck. Get Drills and the Heirloom Blade onto the table and keep them there (the Mastery protects Drills), enter Combat every turn because the aspect 1 power digs eight cards deep for a Sword card on entry, and turn that card advantage into Sword Strikes that the Drills make heavy. Sixteen blocks, several of which pay for themselves, so defending is cheap. Five aspects make the Ascension win a long road; aspects are taken as they come, not chased.
name: freestyle_swords
